title: Maximum Penalty Surcharges and Calculation Standards by Type of Violation (Re: Article 13(2))
full_text:
Maximum Penalty Surcharges and Calculation Standards by Type of Violation (Re: Article 13(2))
■ Enforcement Decree of Internet Multimedia Broadcast Services Act [Appendix 2] <Amended 2025. 10. 1.>

Maximum Penalty Surcharges and Calculation Standards by Type of Violation (Re: Article 13(2))

1. Maximum penalty surcharges by type of violation

(a) Acts falling under Article 17(1)1, 2, and 4 of the Act: Not more than 10/1000 of sales.

(b) Acts falling under Article 17(1)3 of the Act: Not more than 15/1000 of sales.

(c) Acts falling under Article 17(1)5 through 7 of the Act: Not more than 20/1000 of sales.

(d) Where sales are non-existent or difficult to calculate: Not more than 500 million won.

2. Procedure and standards for calculating penalty surcharges

(a) Stages of calculation

A penalty surcharge shall be calculated by applying mandatory increases, additional increases, and reductions to the base amount, taking into consideration the factors to be considered under the main clause of Article 17(2) of the Act and factors affecting them, including whether the person took a leading role in the violation and the impact on the relevant market.

(b) Calculation methods and factors to be considered at each stage

1) Calculation of the base amount

(a) The base amount shall be the sales from services directly or indirectly affected by the violation during the period in which the Internet multimedia broadcast service provider committed that violation (hereinafter referred to as "relevant sales"), multiplied by the applicable rate under item (b), but shall not exceed 2/100 of relevant sales.

(b) The applicable rate shall be determined as follows, according to the degree of seriousness classified pursuant to item (e):

| Degree of seriousness | Applicable rate |
| --- | --- |
| Very serious violation | 1%–2% |
| Serious violation | 0.5%–1% |
| Violation that is not serious | Not more than 0.5% |

(c) In calculating relevant sales, the period of the violation shall run from its commencement date to its termination date and shall be determined by considering whether the benefits or harm resulting from the violation persist, whether the violation is continuous, and other relevant factors. Relevant sales shall be determined on the basis of accounting records, such as business reports.

(d) Where relevant sales are non-existent or difficult to calculate, the degree of seriousness shall be determined pursuant to item (e), and the base amount for each degree of seriousness shall be as classified in the following table. The base amount shall be calculated by comprehensively considering accounting records, such as the financial statements of the relevant Internet multimedia broadcast service provider and providers of similar services; business data, such as subscriber numbers and service charges; and other factors, including past performance, business plans, and market conditions.

| Degree of seriousness | Base amount |
| --- | --- |
| Very serious violation | More than 300 million won and not more than 400 million won |
| Serious violation | More than 200 million won and not more than 300 million won |
| Violation that is not serious | Not more than 200 million won |

(e) In determining the seriousness of a violation under items (b) and (d), the following matters relating to the violation shall be considered comprehensively:

(1) Its impact on the market, including whether it has fundamentally distorted the market;

(2) The scale of harm to users;

(3) The extent of efforts by the service provider that committed the violation to remedy harm to users.

2) Mandatory increases

(a) An increase of up to 50/100 of the base amount shall be added to the base amount, taking into account the duration and frequency of the violation. The resulting amount shall be compared with an amount equivalent to the benefit obtained through the violation, and the greater of the two shall be the amount after mandatory increases.

(b) The duration of a violation shall be classified as short, medium, or long, with differentiated increases. Where the same violation is repeated, the increase shall be proportional to the number of repeated violations.

3) Additional increases and reductions

The amount after mandatory increases shall be increased or reduced by up to 50/100 of that amount, taking into account whether the person took a leading role in the violation; whether the violation was intentional or negligent; whether the person cooperated with the investigation; whether the violation continued or expanded during the investigation; and the impact of the violation on the relevant market, such as changes in market share or subscriber numbers resulting from the violation.

3. Detailed standards

The Korea Media and Communications Commission shall determine and publicly notify detailed factors to be considered at each stage of calculating the base amount, mandatory increases, and additional increases and reductions; detailed standards for the rates of increase and reduction; and other detailed matters and methods necessary for imposing penalty surcharges.
